steps.title: Rebuild the working instructions
steps.explanation: Keep the supplied function and result list. Rebuild the part that fills the list using the example as a guide. Re-run whenever you want to check a change.
steps.task: Fill the result list using this topic's rule.
hints: There are n desks and n clerks, both numbered from 0. Here, n is the length of readings. Each number in readings is a permission mask for one desk. A mask uses binary digits. Each digit is called a bit: a 1 in bit c allows clerk c to use that desk. Bit 0 is the rightmost digit. Assign exactly one clerk to each desk, with no clerk used twice. Follow every permission mask. For each clerk c, count the complete assignments where clerk c gets desk 0. Put those counts in clerk order. A forbidden first choice has count 0. With no desks, the result list is empty.
Revisit the example and copy one instruction at a time, checking what it does.
